verdicts.reason: A is slightly better. Both turn the full-width yellow hashtag band into a small inset box, leave a dead gap between the headline and the list, and set the list and the yellow footer copy very small for a 160px skyscraper. In A, 'Sore throat Headache' is wrongly merged onto one line, but the rest of the list reads well. B has worse list breaks: 'Shortness of breath Dry / cough' splits a symptom across two lines and also merges 'Sore throat Headache', so the six items can't be counted, and its tracking is tighter and harder to read.
